title: System Security & Updates
description: Keep your HP OMEN secure and up-to-date. Configure Windows Security, manage updates, and set up proper backups for peace of mind.

steps.title: Windows Security Settings
steps.content:
Configure essential Windows Security features:

**Windows Defender Antivirus** (Critical)
Location: Windows Security → Virus & threat protection
✓ Keep enabled with real-time protection on

**Firewall & Network Protection** (Critical)
Location: Windows Security → Firewall & network protection
✓ Keep enabled for all network types

**Controlled Folder Access** (Recommended)
Location: Windows Security → Ransomware protection
✓ Enable to protect important folders from ransomware

**Core Isolation** (Recommended)
Location: Windows Security → Device security → Core isolation
✓ Enable Memory Integrity for enhanced security

infoBox.title: Important
infoBox.content: Never disable Windows Defender unless you have another reputable antivirus installed. Your gaming laptop is a valuable target for malware.

steps.title: Update Management
steps.content:
Keep your system up to date for security and performance:

**Windows Update**
Location: Settings → Windows Update
• Check for updates weekly
• Install security updates promptly
• Schedule restarts for convenient times
• Pause updates only when necessary

**Driver Updates**
Location: Settings → Windows Update → Advanced options → Optional updates
• Review optional driver updates carefully
• Prefer manufacturer drivers for GPU
• Keep chipset drivers updated
• Backup before major driver changes

**Microsoft Store Apps**
Location: Microsoft Store → Library
• Enable automatic updates for apps
• Regularly update OMEN Command Center
• Keep Xbox app updated for Game Pass
• Update system apps periodically

steps.title: Backup & Recovery
steps.content:
Protect your data with proper backup strategies:

**System Restore**
Create restore points before major changes
Location: Create a restore point (search)
Frequency: Before driver/software installs

**File History**
Automatic backup of personal files
Location: Settings → Accounts → Windows backup
Frequency: Continuous (hourly)

**Recovery Drive**
Bootable drive to recover Windows
Location: Create a recovery drive (search)
Frequency: Once (update after major Windows updates)

**System Image**
Full system backup including Windows
Location: Control Panel → Backup and Restore
Frequency: Monthly or before major changes

steps.title: Gaming & Security Balance
steps.content:
Optimize security settings for gaming without compromising protection:

**Add game folders to exclusions**
Prevent antivirus from scanning game files during gameplay
How: Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Exclusions → Add folder

**Use Gaming Mode**
Reduces Windows Defender notifications during games
How: Settings → Gaming → Game Mode → On

**Verify game integrity**
Fix corrupted files that may trigger false positives
How: Steam/Epic → Game Properties → Verify Integrity

infoBox.title: Security Tip
infoBox.content: Only add exclusions for trusted sources like Steam, Epic, GOG, or official game installers. Never add exclusions for downloaded files from unknown sources.

steps.title: Weekly Security Checklist
steps.content:
Perform these tasks weekly to maintain security:

☐ Check Windows Update for new updates
☐ Run Windows Security quick scan
☐ Verify backup is working
☐ Review recent app installations
☐ Check browser extensions
☐ Update password manager

infoBox.title: Good Practice
infoBox.content: Set a weekly reminder to go through this checklist. Regular maintenance prevents most security issues before they become problems.
